reason: The historical MMR name-entry handoff explicitly leaves physical code width, name table encoding, buffer format, terminator and save format unresolved. Dialogue private08 encoding must not be assumed to be name-entry encoding.
allowed_use: Search for a possible private08-form 4-page table as reconnaissance.
If it matches, treat the hit as a candidate requiring independent original-JP code-path confirmation.
forbidden_use: Do not fail a valid build solely because private08 page payloads are absent.
Do not promote private08 as name-entry authority without physical path evidence.
Do not use dialogue KS2350 IDs as name-buffer codes by assumption.
